title: A Letter to Sam

readiness.reading: choosing and reading words to write a letter

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: What a fortnight in Bellhaven: the new book, the market, the singing glasses and the fair!

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Would you like to write to Sam, to thank him? Friends who live far apart can still be close in a letter.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Write the letter: choose a word for each coloured space.
lines: I liked the {thing} at the fair.
I will come to the library {when}.
Thank you for a wonderful fair.
I hope you will visit the valley {when}.

book: the new book from the monastery

feedback.all_good: A lovely letter. Sam will keep it in his favourite book!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Off it goes, up the north road. I think Sam will read it more than once.

journal_line: I wrote a thank-you letter to Sam in Bellhaven.
